chunwei.name: Chun Wei Chen
bio: Technical Lead of Proyecto HIS — Taiwan ICDF's national hospital information system program in Paraguay — since January 2020.
Leads development of the inpatient system and operations across 90+ servers nationwide, serving roughly 30,000 healthcare workers and over 1.5 million patient visits every month.
Directed the application stack's evolution from a monolithic legacy HIS to a decoupled architecture: a Next.js frontend backed by a modernized Java REST API.

Guided the infrastructure's progression from a single-node setup to a highly available Kubernetes cluster — Terraform for IaC, Helm-based GitOps, and full observability — for resilient infrastructure with minimal operational overhead.
Introduced the HL7 FHIR standard alongside the existing system, enabling interoperability with international healthcare data formats without disrupting production stability.
Built the team's hiring pipeline, development process, and technical documentation, and introduced AI-assisted development workflows to sustain the technical department's long-term growth.
Now leading the design of AI-powered applications — natural-language-to-SQL, an AI support agent, and an AI-assisted code review cycle — extending the program's transformation from digital to AI.

yuejie.name: Yun Jie Zhang
bio: Software engineer with 2+ years leading the development and operations of hospital OPD/ED systems across 93 servers in Paraguay — serving over one million patient visits every month.
Built and maintained the core HIS stack (Java · PostgreSQL · Tomcat), then led a progressive frontend modernisation to Next.js (React + TypeScript), replacing legacy JSP with minimal disruption.
Engineered deep integrations with LIS and PACS: bi-directional lab data exchange and DICOM-standard QIDO-RS queries that let clinicians access medical images directly in their workflow.
Co-built the team's hiring process, coding standards, and documentation culture, and introduced AI-assisted development tools to accelerate knowledge transfer.
Now applying that production-hardened instinct to design tailored software and AI workflows for businesses.
